comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks an industrial shock absorber; record routes, adjusts, and buckles a doll harness in an infant car seat.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires rigid-tool alignment, fastener release, fine rotary adjustment, counterholding, and dynamic commissioning. Record requires deformable webbing routing, untwisting, material-conserving tightening, and buckle/clip operation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe carriage cycles and measured post-lock drift resistance. Record requires both shoulder and lap routes, untwisted webbing, adjustment, buckling, and a one-second hold; whole-harness migration remains unvalidated. Structured specs and full numeric rubric details are absent.
comparison.reason: Rigid damper adjustment and force-response verification test a meaningfully different ability from deformable harness routing and securement.
